Tourists walk straight past this place on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo. Their loss.

Saigonese Eatery is pulling 4.6 stars across 2,175 reviews and still somehow flies under the radar. Asian fusion done right, $15-30 a head. The kind of spot where locals eat, not perform.

129 Đường Trần Hưng Đạo, Khu phố 7. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
